Each tutorial takes 30 minutes or less. If you are new to census data, start with **Census 101**. Then pick the R track or the Python track. Both tracks cover the same ground, so you only need one.

Before you begin either coding track, [request a free Census API key](https://api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html){target="_blank"}. It arrives by email within a few minutes.

Much of this material draws on Kyle Walker's free online book, [*Analyzing US Census Data: Methods, Maps, and Models in R*](https://walker-data.com/census-r/){target="_blank"}. It is an excellent next step whichever language you use.
